audioSynthesize.label: Speech Synthesis
audioSynthesize.summary: Text → audio.synthesize Scenario Job → typed audio artifact result.

audioTranscribe.label: Speech Transcribe
audioTranscribe.summary: Audio URL → audio.transcribe Scenario Job → typed transcript result.

voiceCreate.label: Voice Create
voiceCreate.summary: Reference audio or text description → voice.create Scenario Job → reusable VoiceAsset.

speechBundle.label: Voice Catalog
speechBundle.summary: Inspect owner-scoped voice references through the protected Runtime voice catalog.

audioSynthesize.inputPlaceholder: Enter the text to synthesize into speech…
audioSynthesize.emptyHint: The synthesized audio will appear here once the job returns.
audioSynthesize.footnote: The runtime returns audio artifacts from the TTS job.

audioTranscribe.inputPlaceholder: https://… pointing at the audio asset
audioTranscribe.emptyHint: The transcript text will appear here once the job returns.
audioTranscribe.footnote: Provide an HTTPS URL or a local audio file up to 32 MiB; the runtime returns the transcript.

voiceCreate.inputPlaceholder: Describe the voice, or provide the transcript spoken in the reference audio…
voiceCreate.emptyHint: The Runtime VoiceAsset will appear here once the job completes.
voiceCreate.footnote: Choose reference audio or text description; Runtime selects the configured voice.create implementation.

speechBundle.inputNote: No input required — this lists the runtime voice catalog.
speechBundle.emptyHint: Available runtime voices will appear here.
speechBundle.footnote: Exercises the typed audio.synthesize voice catalog surface.

parameters.audioFileTooLarge: Audio files must not exceed 32 MiB.
parameters.voiceReferenceFileTooLarge: Reference audio must be non-empty and not exceed 20 MiB.
parameters.voiceReferenceMimeUnsupported: Choose a file with an audio MIME type.
